# DevHunt

> DevHunt (https://devhunt.org) is a launchpad for developer tools, built by developers. Makers submit dev tools, each week's launches are voted on by signed-in developers (GitHub or Google login), and the top tools become weekly winners. It is an open-source alternative to Product Hunt focused only on developer tools.

- Free listing: every tool gets a permanent page at /tool/{slug}; free launches wait in a queue.
- Paid launch ($49, one time): pick any launch week, get a home page spotlight and a dofollow link.
- Sponsor ads: home page and weekly newsletter placements (see /advertise).
- Source code: https://github.com/MarsX-dev/devhunt
- Founder: John Rush (https://johnrush.me, https://x.com/johnrush)

## Key pages

- [Home: this week's launches](https://devhunt.org/): tools launching this week, ranked by votes
- [Upcoming launches](https://devhunt.org/upcoming): tools scheduled for future weeks
- [All dev tools](https://devhunt.org/all-dev-tools): every listed tool
- [FAQ](https://devhunt.org/faq): how launching, voting and pricing work
- [About DevHunt](https://devhunt.org/the-story): who builds DevHunt and what can launch here
- [Advertise](https://devhunt.org/advertise): sponsor placements
- [Blog](https://devhunt.org/blog): guides and roundups of developer tools
- [State of Dev Tools 2026](https://devhunt.org/reports/state-of-dev-tools-2026): original data on 9,400 dev tool launches (AI agents, MCP, AI coding, pricing, open source)
- [Best new dev tools by month](https://devhunt.org/best): the most upvoted launches of each month since 2024
- [Product Hunt alternatives for developer tools](https://devhunt.org/product-hunt-alternatives): where to launch a dev tool, compared by cycle, cost and audience
- [Stats](https://devhunt.org/stats): live DevHunt traffic, launches and impressions

## Tool pages

- Tool profile: https://devhunt.org/tool/{slug}
- Alternatives to a tool: https://devhunt.org/tool/{slug}/alternatives
- Head-to-head comparison: https://devhunt.org/compare/{a}-vs-{b}
